fields.title: Quick start
fields.description: A brick, a collection, a page that renders it, and an admin to edit it.

data.title: Don't destructure props
data.body: Read `props.data.heading` where you use it. Destructuring props breaks Solid's reactivity, and the admin's live preview relies on it.

data.title: Guard the admin
data.body: Anyone who can reach `/admin` and the save and delete functions can use them until you add sign-in. See [Sign-in](/docs/sign-in): `@mortar-kit/auth` guards the routes in middleware and each write in its server function.
